data.name: Kitty Burger
data.detailed_description:
Kitty Burger is a cozy time-management simulation game where you run a burger shop together with your adorable cat assistant! Prepare delicious burgers, serve customers on time, and keep your little restaurant running smoothly. Between busy workdays, you'll meet different characters who visit your shop, each with their own stories, moods, and quirks. How you interact with them will influence the course of the game, unlocking unique story moments and multiple endings that shape the future of your little burger shop.

PREPARE THE BURGER

Prepare the burgers warm and with care! Place the bun, patty, and other ingredients on the burger conveyor, slide the conveyor down, and your burger is ready!

CUSTOMER ORDER

Examine customer orders carefully and try to prepare the correct burgers. Remember: every correct order means a satisfied customer.

END OF DAY

Pay attention to the end of the day! Customers leave the shop at the end of the day. Try to get the orders out on time and finish the day as successfully as possible.

TIME MANAGEMENT

If you can't keep up with the orders, you can try to distract the customers; give them a ball of yarn to divert their attention, and try to use your time more efficiently.

SUPPORT YOUR ASSISTANT

Support your assistant, be there for them in difficult times, and try to manage the shop together.



Features

- Cozy and relaxing time-management gameplay

- Run your own burger shop with the help of your adorable cat assistant

- Meet charming characters who visit your shop and influence the story

- Multiple story paths and endings shaped by your interactions

- Upgrade your shop and speed up your workflow with daily earnings

- Increasing challenge as days progress

- Cute and expressive cat-themed visuals and animations

data.short_description: Ready for a peaceful day at Kitty Burger? Prepare warm burgers for your purring customers, complete their orders with care, and end the day surrounded by cheerful cat chatter. Kitty Burger is the cozy feline haven you’ve been looking for to escape the stress of the day.
data.supported_languages: English, Turkish, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Spanish - Latin America

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Pentium 4
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Basic hardware can easily run the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
